name: what-changed-example
description: The same pre-commit hook as git-pre-commit-hook-example, but it runs only the work that the change affects.

scripts.compile: node --check src/greet.js && what-changed baseline capture compile
scripts.test: node --test --test-reporter=spec test/ && what-changed baseline capture test
scripts.e2e: node e2e/slow-check.js && what-changed baseline capture e2e
